paragraphs: Qualcomm Incorporated () is an American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing, including next-generation mobile networks, smart devices, and semiconductors — such as mobile processors and artificial intelligence chips. The company holds essential patents for global mobile communication standards including 5G, 4G, CDMA2000, TD-SCDMA and WCDMA.

Founded in 1985 by Irwin Jacobs and six other co-founders, Qualcomm's early research into code-division multiple access (CDMA) wireless technology  was financed through revenue from its Omnitracs satellite communications system. CDMA was later adopted as a 2G standard in North America, incorporating Qualcomm patents. This adoption led to licensing disputes over pricing and access to essential patents.

Over time, Qualcomm expanded into semiconductor products, operating largely under a fabless manufacturing model. Its Snapdragon line of processors is widely used in smartphones and other smart devices by multiple manufacturers. In recent years, Qualcomm has been expanding into areas including embedded artificial intelligence, automotive applications, the Internet of Things (IoT), augmented reality, and virtual reality, in addition to developing the Dragonwing product line, aimed at industrial and enterprise solutions with a focus on embedded AI, edge computing, and advanced connectivity.

In addition to its technological activities, Qualcomm has faced legal and regulatory disputes in several countries, particularly concerning patent licensing and competition practices. The company has been involved in antitrust cases led by authorities in the United States, the European Union, and Asia, as well as litigation with manufacturers such as Apple.

people.name: Cristiano R. Amon
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Mr. Amon joined Qualcomm in 1995 as an engineer and has served as President and Chief Executive Officer and a board member since June 2021. He previously served as President and held leadership positions in QTI and QCT.
people.quote: Cristiano R. Amon, age 56, has served as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board of Directors since June 2021.

people.name: Heather Ace
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Ms. Ace has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer since March 2020. Before joining Qualcomm, she was Senior Vice President, Human Resources at DexCom from July 2016 to March 2020.
people.quote: Heather Ace, age 56, has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer since March 2020.

people.name: Baaziz Achour
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer, QTI
people.bio: Dr. Achour joined Qualcomm as a Systems Engineer in 1993 and has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer, QTI since February 2025. His prior roles included Deputy Chief Technology Officer and Senior Vice President, Engineering.
people.quote: Baaziz Achour, age 65, has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer, QTI since February 2025.

people.name: Ann Chaplin
people.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Ms. Chaplin has served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since November 2021. Before joining Qualcomm, she held legal leadership roles at General Motors and was an attorney at Fish & Richardson.
people.quote: Ann Chaplin, age 53, has served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since November 2021.

people.name: Akash Palkhiwala
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Mr. Palkhiwala has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer since November 2019 and additionally as Chief Operating Officer since January 2024. He joined Qualcomm in March 2001 and previously held finance and treasury leadership roles.
people.quote: Akash Palkhiwala, age 51, has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer since November 2019 and also as Chief Operating Officer since January 2024.

people.name: Alexander H. Rogers
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, QTL and Global Affairs
people.bio: Mr. Rogers joined Qualcomm in January 2001 as an attorney and has served as Executive Vice President and President, QTL and Global Affairs since June 2021. He previously led Qualcomm's litigation group and held QTL and legal leadership roles.
people.quote: Alexander H. Rogers, age 69, has served as Executive Vice President and President, QTL and Global Affairs since June 2021.
